text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action from the Champions League, as Roma visit Manchester United in crisis, while Inter try to shake off poor results away to Feyenoord.
They both kick off at 20.00 GMT (21.00 CET).
The Giallorossi lost only one match all season, the 4-3 thriller to Real Madrid they had been leading 3-1, and now try to put the final nail in Michael Carrick’s Manchester United coffin.
Inter have been dire in the Champions League so far, losing to Real Madrid and Club Brugge, then scraping a 1-0 win over Shakhtar Donetsk, so now visit a Feyenoord side who already beat Como here.
- All
- Favourites 0
Inter made a strong Champions League statement with a 3-0 victory away to Feyenoord thanks to Yann Bisseck, Pio Esposito and Piotr Zielinski goals.
Roma once again threw away a two-goal Champions League advantage in a 3-2 defeat to Manchester United, as after dominating the first half, they repeated past mistakes.
Castro is lucky he’s offside, because not sure what he was trying to do with that header…
Into 5 minutes of added time.
And Man Utd see Matheus Cunha sent off!
He was booked for taking his shirt off to celebrate the third goal, then went into a wild tackle on Balerdi!
De Ligt and Mount on, Bruno Fernandes and Maguire off.
So very Roma. Matheus Cunha gathers a smart ball just outside the area, gets past an exhausted Balerdi and blasts in at the near post, literally in OFF the near post.
Maguire, surely that has to be a second yellow… He’s on the ground after a foul on Castro and then holds his leg to prevent him getting away…
Remember all the good stuff we said about Balerdi? Scrap it.
Horribly scuffed attempted clearance turns into an assist for Matheus Cunha inside his own penalty area.
Nobody self-destructs like Roma.
Sucic and Stankovic on, Barella and Zielinski off.
Deijl on, Kraaijveld off.
Castro on for Malen.
Castro immediately harassed Maguire into an error, is held back by an arm in the face, yellow card for the defender.
Lacey goes down under a Wesley challenge, but he’d already taken the cross, so it didn’t make any difference…
Ndicka Ghilardi and on, Hermoso and Mancini off.
Heaven and Diallo off, Lisandro Martinez and Lacey on.
Fireworks getting on the pitch. More worrying, there’s one stuck on the roof…
How did it get up there?!
Balerdi making huge tackles all over the place for Roma here, Soule’ was too busy arguing over a potential handball to track back.
Heaven booked for a clumsy lunge on Soule’.
That was a lot tighter than it looked. Esposito was almost level with the ball…
Esposito tapped in from the Dimarco roll across, but was offside.
This time by Cristante on the other corner!
Maguire header on the corner, Wesley deflects it off the line almost by accident!
We saw Roma throw away a 3-1 lead in 7 minutes, so this shouldn’t be entirely surprising. But they have time to wake up.
Man Utd pouring forward now, Diallo shot blocked, then Mbeumo wins a corner with a desperate Balerdi sliding tackle from six yards.
Triple change.
Watanabe, Steijn and Schaken on, Read, Ferri and Javi Lopez off.
Bonny and Mkhitaryan on, Thuram and Calhanoglu off
What was that?!
Offside trap caught out, Mbeumo is falling over when his shot beats Vasquez, bounces off one upright, rolls across the face of goal, bounces off the other!

משחקי ליגת האלופות מפגישים את מנצ'סטר יונייטד ורומא באנגליה, לצד מפגש בין פיינורד לאינטר. רומא הגיעה למשחק לאחר רצף תוצאות ומאבק צמוד, בעוד אינטר מנסה לשפר את מאזנה במפעל האירופי.

במהלך המשחק בין מנצ'סטר יונייטד לרומא, רומא שוב שמטה יתרון לאחר מחצית ראשונה טובה, ומאטה קוניה הבקיע שער דרמטי עבור יונייטד לפני שהורחק בכרטיס צהוב שני בעקבות חגיגה ותיקול פרוע. מנגד, אינטר רשמה הופעה חזקה מול פיינורד עם שערים של יאן ביסאק, פיו אספוזיטו ופיוטר ז'ילינסקי שהבטיחו לה ניצחון חוץ מרשים.
